run_gif_maker_cli: run the gif maker script with --traj-path and --out-path to generate a GIF from a trajectory file
run_parallelize_generation: run parallelize_generation with a traj file path and output directory to create POV-Ray images and a GIF
run_pov_from_atoms: run pov_from_atoms on an ASE atoms object to render a single POV-Ray snapshot image
run_get_parser: run get_parser to create an argparse parser with traj-path, out-path, and num-workers arguments
run_gif_maker_workers: run the gif maker script with --num-workers to parallelize image generation across multiple processes
